surfaces.function: Public landing page and authenticated CRM shell entry
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The root is the base application entry protected by session, RBAC and tenant guards after authentication; no optional launch feature is selected by the route itself.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Return the canonical alias to the last known-good deployment; no data rollback is required for a read entry.

surfaces.function: Public legal, metadata, deletion and unsubscribe information
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: These mandatory public documents are content approvals rather than an optional runtime feature; Legal approval remains an independent release gate.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Restore the last signed legal-content revision and previous deployment; preserve unsubscribe audit records.

surfaces.function: Public meeting pages and short-link redirects
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The route shell is inventoried separately; booking creation and lifecycle mutations are governed by their dedicated launch-scope keys.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep booking mutation scopes OFF and serve the contact fallback; roll back the deployment if read routing regresses.

surfaces.function: Login, forgot-password and reset-password pages
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Authentication pages are core access surfaces; password-reset email delivery is independently governed by accountAccessPasswordResetEmail.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Roll back to the last known-good authentication deployment and retain active session and audit data.

surfaces.function: Public form resolution, page rendering and embed shell
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Read-only form resolution and rendering are route-shell concerns; proof, submission and optional field behavior have dedicated launch-scope keys.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Disable published form links or return the previous deployment; keep persisted submissions immutable.

surfaces.function: Preview-only visual QA pages
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: These pages are protected by an explicit Preview guard and are not a customer launch feature.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Remove Preview access or roll back the deployment; Production must continue to reject the pages.

surfaces.function: Internal administration API namespace
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The namespace contains several independently scoped internal operations; their mutation decisions are represented by dedicated launch-scope entries below.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep internal launch scopes closed and roll back the deployment; never broaden roles as a rollback.

surfaces.function: Managed-service approval queue API
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: No dedicated central launch-scope rule exists for the authenticated approval queue; access relies on product permissions.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Revert the deployment and stop approval mutations while preserving the audit history.

surfaces.function: Authentication, CSRF, session, onboarding and password-reset APIs
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Core authentication is mandatory; only the external password-reset send is an optional provider effect with its own scope.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Roll back the application deployment; do not delete sessions, MFA enrollment or password-reset audit records.

surfaces.function: Authenticated bot, knowledge, channel and action APIs
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The base authenticated APIs are permission-controlled; inbound execution, authenticated model completion and external embeddings are separately governed by dedicated fail-closed launch-scope rules.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Enable the bot runtime kill switch, keep provider scopes OFF and revert the deployment without deleting bot audit data.

surfaces.function: Direct Google and Microsoft calendar APIs
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The namespace is fully governed by calendarProviderMutation; the route inventory remains separate from that feature decision.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep calendar read and mutation scopes OFF, revoke Preview OAuth credentials and roll back the deployment.

surfaces.function: Authenticated tenant-scoped CRM APIs
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Core tenant CRUD remains ON while individual relationship, invitation, notification and publication operations have explicit launch-scope rules.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Revert to the last tested deployment; use API cleanup only for QA data and preserve customer records.

surfaces.function: Signed Vercel Cron entrypoints and schedules
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Cron invocation is an internal platform mechanism; each queued or provider effect has its own launch-scope decision.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Pause or remove the affected schedule, keep effect scopes OFF and roll back the deployment; queued records remain retryable.

surfaces.function: Internal form management and public form APIs
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The namespace combines authenticated management and independently scoped public proof/submission operations.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Disable publication or revert the deployment; retain idempotency and submission ledgers for reconciliation.

surfaces.function: Public funnel blueprint, proof, submission, visit and token APIs
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Each funnel operation has its own central launch-scope key; the namespace inventory does not override those decisions.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep visit and token rotation OFF, revoke affected publication at the application layer and restore the last tested deployment.

surfaces.function: Application health endpoint
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: A non-mutating health endpoint is a mandatory operations surface, not an optional product feature.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Roll back the deployment if the health contract changes incompatibly.

surfaces.function: Tenant media listing, upload, publication, protected read and deletion
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Stop writes, retain metadata on provider failure, reconcile orphans, and roll back the application; never delete legacy source objects without separate approval.

surfaces.function: Meeting availability, booking lifecycle, notifications, OAuth and settings
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The namespace combines multiple dedicated OFF scopes for booking, provider reads, provider mutations and communication delivery.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep all meeting provider and public lifecycle scopes OFF, disconnect Preview OAuth, and roll back the deployment.

surfaces.function: Newsletter provider delivery
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The route inventory is separate from the newsletterDelivery decision that blocks the provider effect.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep delivery OFF, cancel unsent QA records through approved cleanup and roll back the deployment.

surfaces.function: Access, password and company-profile settings APIs
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Core settings persistence is permission-controlled; invitation and reset delivery have dedicated provider scopes.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Revert the deployment while preserving approved company-profile versions and access audit records.

surfaces.function: Internal database and migration diagnostics API
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: The route inventory is represented here; the operation itself is governed by systemDatabaseDiagnostics.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep the internal scope restricted and revert the deployment; diagnostics must remain read-only.

surfaces.function: Authenticated workspace discovery and switching
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Workspace switching is controlled by product role and tenant membership rather than an optional provider feature.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Revert the deployment and disable switching while preserving workspace memberships.

surfaces.function: Customer and operational CRM navigation entries
routeApiJob: CRM hash navigation except restricted admin entries
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: Navigation is a presentation and module-permission boundary; launch-sensitive actions behind entries retain their own policy checks.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Restore the previous navigation profile configuration; API permissions remain authoritative.

surfaces.function: Restricted audit, governance and system-release navigation
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: These entries use explicit restricted-admin role filtering; their underlying APIs retain independent permission and launch-scope guards.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Hide all restricted entries and revert the deployment; never relax the product-role allowlist.

surfaces.function: Property export job queue
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Do not enqueue new jobs; leave existing records for audited reconciliation and never mark them completed without a worker.

surfaces.function: External bot knowledge embeddings
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Remove or withhold embedding provider credentials and force the local deterministic fallback before launch.

surfaces.function: Dry-run-first migration of legacy-public Blob objects to isolated private storage
surfaces.launchScopeNotApplicableReason: This is an operator CLI with explicit target and confirmation guards, not an application runtime surface; physical execution requires separate authorization.
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Before source deletion, compare-and-swap metadata back to the verified source reference; source deletion is a separate delayed finalize action.

surfaces.function: Workspace invitation email delivery
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep the scope OFF and preserve invitations as non-delivered records; do not contact Resend.

surfaces.function: Password-reset email delivery
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep email initiation OFF and invalidate any QA reset artifacts through the supported flow.

surfaces.function: Inbound bot webhook processing and CRM mutation
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep inbound processing OFF, enable the bot kill switch, withhold provider credentials and reconcile unfinished webhook leases.

surfaces.function: Authenticated bot chat model completion
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep authenticated model execution OFF; do not parse the chat body, create CRM runtime rows or contact the model provider.

surfaces.function: Google and Microsoft OAuth, token refresh and calendar mutation
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep mutation OFF, disconnect and revoke Preview OAuth credentials, and do not alter Production calendars.

surfaces.function: Google and Microsoft calendar availability reads
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep reads OFF and show the approved unavailable state without refreshing credentials.

surfaces.function: Customer-facing email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and meeting notification delivery
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep provider delivery OFF, leave durable jobs retryable, and reconcile without sending to unapproved targets.

surfaces.function: Outbound funnel submission webhook delivery
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep webhook configuration and delivery OFF; do not replay submissions to external URLs.

surfaces.function: Platform-admin funnel publish-token cutover
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Use the documented internal recovery path; never expose either token in evidence or logs.

surfaces.function: Customer-facing funnel publish-token rotation
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep customer rotation OFF and use only the separately authorized internal cutover procedure.

surfaces.function: CRM import review UI and mutation flow
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep import UI and any future server entrypoints OFF; no import batch should be created.

surfaces.function: External newsletter delivery
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep delivery OFF and reconcile QA send rows without provider contact.

surfaces.function: Unit status, buyer ownership, deal-stage and reservation relationship synchronization
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep relationship mutations and expiry worker OFF; do not infer or backfill business relationships.

surfaces.function: Public meeting booking creation
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep booking creation OFF and show the approved contact fallback; do not create provider events.

surfaces.function: Public booking cancellation and rescheduling
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep public lifecycle actions OFF; use audited internal support procedures for QA cleanup.

surfaces.function: Advanced public form consent variants
routeApiJob: public form DTO and submission validation
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep only the audited privacy-consent contract and reject advanced variants before persistence.

surfaces.function: Custom public form validation patterns
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Strip unsupported custom patterns from public DTOs and reject them server-side.

surfaces.function: Public form file upload
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Reject public file fields before upload, persistence or Blob contact.

surfaces.function: Rate-limited public form proof refresh
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Turn the scope OFF; existing proof values expire naturally and must not be logged or replayed.

surfaces.function: Public form round-robin ownership
routeApiJob: public form DTO and owner assignment
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Use only the fixed approved owner and reject round-robin configuration before publication.

surfaces.function: Spanish public landing and public-language discovery
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep Spanish discovery and public routing OFF; retain ES source copy only for a separately guarded internal Preview review.

surfaces.function: Fixed-owner public form submission
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Turn the scope OFF, preserve idempotency ledgers, and clean only QA submissions through the approved reset API.

surfaces.function: Token-gated public funnel page and blueprint
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Turn publication OFF or restore the prior published revision; never expose publish tokens in logs or evidence.

surfaces.function: Revision-bound public funnel proof refresh
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Turn proof refresh OFF and allow issued proofs to expire without exposing their values.

surfaces.function: Token- and revision-bound public funnel submission
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Turn submission OFF, preserve replay ledgers, and clean QA data only through the approved reset API.

surfaces.function: Consent-bound public funnel visit tracking and retention
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep visit writes OFF; if ever enabled, stop ingestion before audited retention cleanup and metric recomputation.

surfaces.function: Ledger-fenced Preview QA reset
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Use dry-run first, stop on ledger mismatch and never replace the reset API with direct SQL deletion.

surfaces.function: Atomic isolated Preview QA batch capability registration
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Do not reuse or reopen sealed batches; create a new isolated batch after fixing the cause.

surfaces.function: QA-labelled CRM mutations inside registered Preview batches
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Stop the batch and clean it through the registered reset/ledger contract; never reuse its marker.

surfaces.function: Internal database schema and migration diagnostics
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep diagnostics internal and read-only; roll back the deployment on schema projection regressions.

surfaces.function: Google Chat notification queueing, delivery and retry
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep queueing, claiming and provider delivery OFF; reconcile jobs only after target approval.

surfaces.function: Microsoft Teams notification queueing, delivery and retry
surfaces.rollbackBehavior: Keep queueing, claiming and provider delivery OFF; reconcile jobs only after target approval.
